visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor clothing boutique. A man with black hair and a white T-shirt stands center frame. He holds a hanger with a black shirt in his left hand and a hanger with gray shorts in his right. He smiles and gestures towards the camera. The background shows racks of varied clothing and bright ceiling lights. (2) Outdoor street scene. The man walks on a sidewalk next to a green-painted pedestrian lane. He wears a white shirt and black pants. He points to himself and looks frustrated, then points towards the camera. Shops and utility poles line the background. Natural daylight casting soft shadows. (3) Close-up of a store storefront. A white illuminated sign reads "soldout space." The window reflects the street. The camera pans slightly. (4) Inside the boutique. The man browses through white and gray clothing on a rack. He picks out a pair of gray shorts and holds them up, then switches to a black T-shirt with white "BABY" text. Cartoonish flower graphics overlay his face briefly. (5) Dressing area. The man pulls back a gray curtain and steps out wearing the black T-shirt and gray shorts. He puts his hands in his pockets and spins to show the outfit. Lighting is bright and even. (6) Narrow alleyway. The man walks away from the camera, then turns back with a cool expression. The walls are weathered with exposed pipes and air conditioners. Lush green plants grow on the left side. (7) Back outside the store. The man stands next to the storefront sign, smiling and waving his right hand. He touches his chin playfully.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo, upbeat electronic pop music with a strong synth bass and 4/4 beat. A male voice speaks with high energy and friendly inflection. (2) Sharp whoosh SFX indicates a scene change. Low-frequency urban rumble and distant bird chirping are heard. The speaker continues with an animated, slightly exaggerated tone. (3) Percussive "ding" SFX as a location tag appears visually. BGM remains constant. (4) Sound of metallic hangers sliding on a rod. The speaker's voice has a slight room resonance. A short, high-pitched "sparkle" SFX plays. (5) Abrupt shift to a traditional, slow-tempo Chinese ballad for 3 seconds, mixed with the speaker's loud laughter. Then, the upbeat BGM returns with a transient impact sound. (6) Vocal tone shifts to a "presenter" style, enunciating clearly about fashion rules. The beat of the music is prominent. (7) Curtain sliding sound (fabric friction). The speaker shouts "Deng-deng!" with a rising pitch. (8) Synthesized camera shutter "click" SFX repeated three times in sync with visual shifts. BGM volume swells slightly. (9) Closing statement with a lower vocal pitch and warm tone. Final whoosh SFX followed by a quick fade-out of the music and ambient air.
